title: Camp Slot Panic Board
oneLiner: A working-parent command board that compares summer camp slots, true weekly cost, deadlines, waitlist risk, and coverage gaps before school breaks explode.
targetUser: Working parents and caregivers juggling school breaks, multiple children, camp registration windows, and childcare budgets.
keyUx: Enter child ages, school-break weeks, commute limits, budget, and known camps; see sold-out risk, true weekly costs, coverage gaps, sibling conflicts, and a registration attack plan.
externalSignals: Signal 5 — Reddit r/Parenting — summer camp/daycare cost shock: https://www.reddit.com/r/Parenting/comments/1kvnddb/daycare_in_2025/
Signal 6 — Reddit r/Parenting — waitlists and sold-out camp anxiety: https://www.reddit.com/r/Parenting/comments/1jewgd8/the_cost_of_childcare_is_beyond_ridiculous/
stitchPrompt: Design a responsive parent-planning product called Camp Slot Panic Board for working parents trying to secure summer camp and school-break childcare before slots disappear. Users should enter child ages, school-break weeks, commute radius, budget, sibling constraints, and known camps, then compare true weekly cost, activity add-ons, deposit deadlines, waitlist risk, and coverage gaps. Include a school-break coverage calendar, camp slot watchlist, true weekly cost calculator, waitlist and sold-out risk flags, sibling logistics conflict board, registration deadline sprint, and backup-care SOS plan. Design direction: use a calm-consumer aesthetic with soft daylight colors, reassuring cards, gentle urgency states, family-calendar visuals, and clear next-step buttons so stressed parents feel organized instead of judged.
